summary: Preserved PR 2194's valid MLX architecture-resolution bypass and corrected its remaining Hunyuan batched-decode counterexample by delegating model-specific attention through a batched cache adapter. The exact candidate rejects Hunyuan's positional shared-KV argument; the corrected contract probe passes.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before execution of the exact candidate's MLXAttentionWrapper.__call__ with the pinned mlx-lm Hunyuan shared-KV call shape; it raised TypeError because the fourth positional argument was unsupported.
Passing-after routing of Hunyuan's shared-KV positional argument to delegated model attention while preserving return arity.
Five CPU tests passed: MLX skips architecture resolution, while non-MLX resolution, cached implementation behavior, and Transformers fallback boundaries remain intact.
The MLX suite collected 39 tests, including the Hunyuan shared-KV regression, but all 39 were skipped because MLX is unavailable on Linux.
All changed Python sources compile successfully.
No whitespace errors in the patch.

gpu_execution.evidence: The assigned AMD gfx950 GPU is not an Apple Metal device and cannot execute MLX; no unrelated ROCm workload was used as model evidence.

remaining_limitations: No Apple Silicon, MLX, or Metal runtime was available, so the MLX numerical regression could not execute in this environment.
Hunyuan model weights were not downloaded; launch_server and token-for-token equivalence against raw mlx_lm remain unverified here.
The deterministic tiny Llama serving fixture cannot qualify Hunyuan architecture semantics and was therefore not used as substitute evidence.
The fused AOT RoPE path intentionally retains hand-written attention and is only selected for model/kernel combinations that opt into that kernel.
